title: Senior Backend Engineer
jd:
Senior Backend Engineer, Lattice Cloud, Remote (India)
You will lead the design of our event-driven platform.

Required
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Experience designing and operating distributed systems and microservices.
- Strong PostgreSQL or equivalent SQL database skills.
- Production experience with AWS.
- Mentoring other engineers.

Good to have
- Kubernetes.
- Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana).
resume:
Test Candidate D
EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, 2022-present, a logistics platform
- Led a team of four engineers building order-routing microservices in Go, handling 3k requests/second.
- Reduced p99 latency by 40% by redesigning PostgreSQL indexes and adding read replicas.
- Introduced Kafka-based events between services; wrote the on-call runbook and mentored two junior engineers.
Software Engineer, 2019-2022, a fintech company
- Built Python REST services on AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS) and set up Prometheus and Grafana dashboards.
- Deployed services to EKS with Helm.
EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Engineering, 2019.
SKILLS
Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, AWS, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana
